visualizations.title_en: Truth DAG observatory · every genuinely new theorem strictly shrinks the blind spot
visualizations.summary: 十六个态排成 4×4 格点，六条二值定理组成目录：三条水平切线、一条竖直切线、一条可由 T₁、T₂ 推出的定理（T₅ = T₁ ∧ ¬T₂，即 y = 1），以及与 T₄ 同核的双胞胎 T₆。页面逐对枚举全部 120 个无序态对，实时算出联合核的等价类、仍不可分的逃逸对与每条定理的独占捕获：插入 T₄ 让逃逸对从 24 降到 8；插入可恢复的 T₅ 一对也不降；T₄ 与 T₆ 同时在场时独占捕获都为 0。所用的五条性质（联合核的单调性与插入公式、可恢复则不降逃逸、同核双胞胎独占为 0、降低逃逸当且仅当不在语义闭包中）已由 Lean 内核验证并冻结；页面上的数是一个有限例子的穷举，不是证明。
visualizations.summary_en: Sixteen states on a 4×4 lattice and a catalog of six binary theorems: three horizontal cuts, one vertical cut, a theorem that follows from T₁ and T₂ (T₅ = T₁ ∧ ¬T₂, that is y = 1), and T₆, a same-kernel twin of T₄. The page enumerates all 120 unordered pairs and computes, live, the classes of the joint kernel, the pairs that still escape and each theorem's unique capture: inserting T₄ takes the escaped pairs from 24 to 8; inserting the recoverable T₅ removes not one; with T₄ and T₆ both present, both capture 0. The five properties used (the joint kernel is antitone and inserting intersects it, a recoverable theorem does not lower the escape, same-kernel twins both capture 0, lowering the escape is failing to lie in the semantic closure) are kernel-verified in Lean and frozen; the numbers on the page are an exhaustive count of one finite example, not a proof.

visualizations.title_en: FIB ATOM observer · identical on the boundary, apart in lineage
visualizations.summary: 三个场景看同一个对象：组成 (a, b) 与它的可观测量 q = 2a + 3b。嫁接：由一步 Fibonacci 替换 R 与嫁接 G 组成的任意词，作用在组成上恰是 v ↦ stepᵏ(v) + t，平移 t 的模 H 余数落在嫁接空间里。血统：组成为 (a, b) 的有序二叉树共有 Catalan(a + b − 1)·C(a + b, a) 棵；替换 n 代后它们的组成与可观测量完全相同，却只占新纤维的一小部分，全变差 TV(n) = 1 − |纤维(a, b)| / |纤维(stepⁿ(a, b))| 趋于 1，且 TV((1, 1), 1) = 2/3。亏量：黄金进位亏量 c(v₁, v₂) 只取 −1、0、1，收缩面上的三个读数都落在长度为 1 的窗口里。三条结论已由 Lean 内核验证并冻结；页面上的数由精确整数算出，是数值演示，不是证明。
visualizations.summary_en: Three scenes look at one object: a composition (a, b) and its observable quantity q = 2a + 3b. Graft: any word of Fibonacci steps R and grafts G acts on compositions exactly as v ↦ stepᵏ(v) + t, with the residue of the translation t mod H in the graft space. Lineage: there are Catalan(a + b − 1)·C(a + b, a) ordered binary trees of composition (a, b); after n generations of substitution they all show the same composition and quantity, yet fill a vanishing part of the new fiber: the total variation TV(n) = 1 − |Fiber(a, b)| / |Fiber(stepⁿ(a, b))| tends to 1, and TV((1, 1), 1) = 2/3. Deficit: the golden carry deficit c(v₁, v₂) only takes −1, 0 and 1, and the three readings on the contraction face lie in a window of length 1. The three results are kernel-verified in Lean and frozen; the numbers on the page are computed in exact integers, a numerical illustration, not a proof.
